text_block_list.name: Hoshina & Yunohana
text_block_list.text: —Welcome to the Yukoma Inn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the weekend. Accepting the invitation from the other day,
we all came to the hot springs resort for some rest and relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that lovely sulfur scent♪ Well then, without further ado...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh~~~~...♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
How is the water temperature?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's just the right temperature!
Yu~koma~ Hot Springs~~♪
Hmm...♪ Hm hm hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you memorized it for me.
The traditional bath-treading song.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've completely fallen in love with it!
It has so much charm, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what kind words.
Then, with all my hospitality in mind...
*Deep breath*...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yukoma~ hot springs~♪ Dipping your toes in the bath~♪
An Uma-musume~~ perking up her ears~~♪
Pure bliss~~ ah~~♪ Hup, hup!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whoosh, splash, so good...!
Haaah, pure bliss♪ Pure bliss...♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Installing map...
Confirmed numerous lodgings, bathhouses, eateries, and souvenir shops.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yukoma Hot Spring Resort
is a town that flourished around its hot spring sources.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It all started here at our establishment—the "Yukoma Inn,"
opened by the URA for the sake of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
A special hot spring inn dedicated to convalescence
and rehabilitation, aimed at making a full recovery from injury...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"From that point on, rest facilities and research centers gradually increased,
and many racing personnel
began to gather."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: And... today, it has become an onsen town that welcomes regular tourists just like this.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so that's where it comes from...!
Every town really has its own history, huh.
This local history guide... is super informative!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone.
Please take a look at this if you would.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If I may be so bold, I have put together
a recommended 'Hot Spring Tour Plan'
tailored to each and every one of you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Lemme see, lemme see~...?
Mine says "Blood Circulation & Muscle Relaxation Plan"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Recommended activities for a change of pace, and even foods suited to my body type...! I definitely wanna give this a try♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that,
everyone ended up spending their time
relaxing however they pleased.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"To-yaaah!
Yay, it went in!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahhh~~~ it's so warming~~~. There's even a footbath walking course.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Meat, seafood, fresh vegetables. Even dessert...!
Limiter released! Continuing resupply.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, what a starry sky............
I wonder if anyone back in Tomakomai is looking up at it too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, wrap up the pillow fight.
I'm turning off the lights.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Good night... ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Ah, my body is still so warm...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And come Monday, I felt completely full of energy in both mind and body. Training with <chrname> is going smoothly too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good work!
I'm in great shape today!
Yours truly set a brand-new record~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am in top form as well. My increased focus and the corresponding rise in training effectiveness are clearly reflected in the data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this the restorative power of a hot spring resort...?
A sense of profound fulfillment, something lounging at home could never provide, washes over me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They said it was tailored to each individual, but the results are incredible. To be able to create such an optimal plan...
choice_data_list: Maybe she's not just an ordinary landlady?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Hot spring recuperation is said to be good
for post-injury recovery as well...
I'm becoming more and more interested."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Injuries, huh...
Yeah... I'm concerned about that too.
It's something we really should know about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's an unavoidable risk for an Umamusume.
I wanted to know for myself too.
For <chrname>'s sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Tran-san and Tarumae-chan
took a liking to the hot springs too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Shall we all drop by regularly? We'll have plenty of questions for the landladies, too!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—I see that it's to your liking.
We look forward to your continued patronage♪
Please feel free to ask if you have any questions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About the recuperation, about the rehabilitation...
There were so many things I wanted to ask.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Pardon? Did you mean me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The students' expectant gazes gather on me.
Steeling my resolve, I shout."
choice_data_list: Please teach us the secrets of 'rest and recuperation'!
Please teach us the secrets of 'recuperation'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The more I look back on our hot spring tour the other day, the more I realize what an efficient rest it was according to recuperation theory. I enthusiastically explain this to her...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: I see. You noticed even that much? As expected of an active Trainer. You've thoroughly impressed me.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the landlady is a former Trainer, too.
And I was her former trainee♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Yunohana.
Running your mouth again, I see."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... That was a long time ago.
Now I'm just a humble innkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, stop it~.
Even just the other day, you were called in
by the URA for an expert panel."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If our humble knowledge will suffice,
we would be more than happy
to share it with you.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
However... Hrmm...
When it comes to teaching others,
I'm not particularly good at doing it gently...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I treat Yunohana here,
I might end up being a bit rough with you...
Would you still be fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Heh... hehe...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!
Is that so, is that so...?!
Then I can rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Proprietress, were you worried about that?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
Our inn is the face of this hot spring district.
We cannot be disrespectful to our guests.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, calling me "Landlady"?
Somehow that feels a lot
more approachable and friendly~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't hold back on us at all.
Right, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
My, what energetic responses from everyone.
I look forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the group began visiting the Yukoma Hot Springs to learn the true meaning of "recuperation."
......However!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, the footbath here is the absolute best today too!
And yet... to think this whole hot spring resort town might disappear...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...?
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
What did you just say!?

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text: Ah, there are rumors like that. Lately the water volume and temperature have dropped, and because of that, customers are dwindling, so they say...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Such a rumor...!?
Please, tell me more about that—!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, is that all?
It's been like that for years now.
It's sad, but that's just the times, I suppose.”

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: "The decrease in water volume is one reason, but in recent years, fewer girls have been coming here to rehabilitate injuries in the first place."
choice_data_list: Why? It's such a nice hot spring, though...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just because more options opened up over time.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Training techniques improve every day.
And so do methods for treating and preventing injuries.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Facilities outside Tracen Academy have been upgraded too.
We've got plenty of options beyond the traditional hot spring retreats now.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's a good thing for the racing world.
They talk about rehabilitation, but really,
not getting injured in the first place is what's best.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I've been putting effort not just into rehabilitation, but into 'refreshing' as well, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: That still needs quite a bit more publicity, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, what everyone did for me the other day
was essentially just that.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing your mind and body is
the absolute best way to prevent injuries and illness!
choice_data_list: (I see... Resting is a form of "prevention.")

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... makes sense.
However... all the more reason then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We can't let this hot spring town disappear. Isn't it a totally valid option?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, Young Mistress!
We really need to spread the word about how important 'refreshing' is...!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your consideration.
Actually, our inn does have some plans in the works too♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
According to the geological survey,
there seem to be more hot spring sources
sleeping nearby.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Yes, a new hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
If we strike a spring, hot water will come gushing out♪
It'll be all the talk, for sure.
We'll have tons of guests coming over!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand next, the location of
the new hot spring source is...
Ta-da-da-daaa~♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
With the "Hot Spring Detector"~~♪
we can easily find it!
The proprietress invented it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You have a super gadget like that?! If we know where it is, all that's left is to dig it up...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, easy there, Lady Tran.
Even if we know the location,
it's still difficult to begin excavation just yet.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The real issue is heavy machinery can't get in there.
Digging by hand takes more manpower and budget than we have...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see... Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone.
Don't you think there's real romance
in striking a hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right, Accu-san!
Such a thrilling experience,
I'd gladly pay money to do it again♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I totally agree!
We get to soak in a new hot spring, right~?
Sounds like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Me too. Since I'm here to learn about recuperation, I wanted to help out with something."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything else we can do
besides excavating the hot springs?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Selected Operation: "Hot Springs Revitalization."
...Shall I execute this task?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...!
Landlady, what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Mm... I wouldn't want them overworking themselves, but
it's truly a blessing to have so many Umamusume
lending a hand...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Alright... then I'm counting on you!
Remember, rest and recovery come first.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, let's take it nice and easy
and dig away~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, while recuperating, the group decided to help out in various ways to revitalize the Yukoma Hot Springs!
